BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning the rental of self-service storage facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the rental of self-service storage facilities; and adding a new section to chapter 19.150 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 19.150 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: An occupant may not use a self-service storage facility for residential purposes, and a self-service storage facility is not subject to the provisions of the residential landlord-tenant act under chapter 59.18 RCW.
